1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.OctahedralSubdivision
2 
3 /-! Actual spatial triangle angles and their six-vertex total curvature identity. -/
4 
5 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
6 
7 open OctahedralTriangles EuclideanGeometry
8 
9 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
10 
11 /-- The ordinary spatial angle at a named corner of a subdivision triangle. -/
12 noncomputable def cornerAngle (t : Fin 8) (i : Fin 3) : ℝ :=
13   angle (graph.trianglePoint t (i + 1)) (graph.trianglePoint t i) (graph.trianglePoint t (i + 2))
14 
15 /-- The sum of the incident subdivision angles at one original vertex. -/
16 noncomputable def totalAngleAt (v : Fin 6) : ℝ :=
17   ∑ t : Fin 8, ∑ i : Fin 3, if corner t i = v then graph.cornerAngle t i else 0
18 
19 /-- Curvature is the angular deficit at this genuine original vertex. -/
20 noncomputable def curvature (v : Fin 6) : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi - graph.totalAngleAt v
21 
22 /-- The three cyclically ordered corners remain noncollinear. -/
23 theorem corner_triangle_not_collinear (t : Fin 8) (i : Fin 3) :
24     ¬ Collinear ℝ ({graph.trianglePoint t (i + 1), graph.trianglePoint t i,
25       graph.trianglePoint t (i + 2)} : Set Space) := by
26   apply P.no_three_collinear_vertices
27     (graph.vertex (corner t (i + 1))).property (graph.vertex (corner t i)).property
28     (graph.vertex (corner t (i + 2))).property
29   · exact (graph.trianglePoint_injective t).ne ((by decide : ∀ i : Fin 3, i + 1 ≠ i) i)
30   · exact (graph.trianglePoint_injective t).ne ((by decide : ∀ i : Fin 3, i + 1 ≠ i + 2) i)
31   · exact (graph.trianglePoint_injective t).ne ((by decide : ∀ i : Fin 3, i ≠ i + 2) i)
32 
33 theorem cornerAngle_pos (t : Fin 8) (i : Fin 3) : 0 < graph.cornerAngle t i :=
34   angle_pos_of_not_collinear (graph.corner_triangle_not_collinear t i)
35 
36 theorem cornerAngle_lt_pi (t : Fin 8) (i : Fin 3) : graph.cornerAngle t i < Real.pi :=
37   angle_lt_pi_of_not_collinear (graph.corner_triangle_not_collinear t i)
38 
39 /-- Each actual subdivision triangle contributes exactly pi in angle sum. -/
40 theorem sum_cornerAngle (t : Fin 8) : ∑ i : Fin 3, graph.cornerAngle t i = Real.pi := by
41   have total := angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi (graph.trianglePoint t 2)
42     ((graph.trianglePoint_injective t).ne (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0))
43   simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, cornerAngle]
44   change angle (graph.trianglePoint t 1) (graph.trianglePoint t 0) (graph.trianglePoint t 2) +
45     angle (graph.trianglePoint t 2) (graph.trianglePoint t 1) (graph.trianglePoint t 0) +
46     angle (graph.trianglePoint t 0) (graph.trianglePoint t 2) (graph.trianglePoint t 1) = Real.pi
47   rw [angle_comm (graph.trianglePoint t 1) (graph.trianglePoint t 0),
48     angle_comm (graph.trianglePoint t 2) (graph.trianglePoint t 1),
49     angle_comm (graph.trianglePoint t 0) (graph.trianglePoint t 2)]
50   linarith
51 
52 /-- The 24 corner angles are counted exactly once across the six original vertices. -/
53 theorem sum_totalAngleAt : ∑ v : Fin 6, graph.totalAngleAt v = 8 * Real.pi := by
54   unfold totalAngleAt
55   calc
56     (∑ v : Fin 6, ∑ t : Fin 8, ∑ i : Fin 3, if corner t i = v then graph.cornerAngle t i else 0) =
57         ∑ t : Fin 8, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ v : Fin 6, if corner t i = v then graph.cornerAngle t i else 0 := by
58       rw [Finset.sum_comm]
59       apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
60       intro t member
61       rw [Finset.sum_comm]
62     _ = ∑ t : Fin 8, ∑ i : Fin 3, graph.cornerAngle t i := by simp
63     _ = 8 * Real.pi := by simp [graph.sum_cornerAngle]
64 
65 /-- Gauss--Bonnet for this explicit six-vertex subdivision, derived from its actual spatial angles. -/
66 theorem sum_curvature : ∑ v : Fin 6, graph.curvature v = 4 * Real.pi := by
67   simp only [curvature, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, graph.sum_totalAngleAt]
68   norm_num
69   ring
70 
71 /-- Every vertex has a positive incident angle sum. -/
72 theorem totalAngleAt_pos (v : Fin 6) : 0 < graph.totalAngleAt v := by
73   obtain ⟨t, i, at_vertex⟩ := (by decide : ∀ v : Fin 6, ∃ t : Fin 8, ∃ i : Fin 3, corner t i = v) v
74   have nonnegative (t : Fin 8) (i : Fin 3) : 0 ≤ if corner t i = v then graph.cornerAngle t i else 0 := by
75     split_ifs
76     · exact (graph.cornerAngle_pos t i).le
77     · exact le_rfl
78   apply Finset.sum_pos' (fun t _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => nonnegative t i))
79   refine ⟨t, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
80   apply Finset.sum_pos' (fun i _ => nonnegative t i)
81   exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, by rw [if_pos at_vertex]; exact graph.cornerAngle_pos t i⟩
82 
83 /-- The upper curvature bound follows from nondegenerate actual face angles. -/
84 theorem curvature_lt_two_pi (v : Fin 6) : graph.curvature v < 2 * Real.pi := by
85   have positive := graph.totalAngleAt_pos v
86   unfold curvature
87   linarith
88 
89 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
